team.fullBio: Dr. Abdo H. Guroob is an academic professional and Senior Lecturer in Computer Science and Information Technology, with expertise in Big Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, and Machine Learning. His academic and research work focuses on developing intelligent, data-driven, scalable, and distributed computing solutions to address complex educational, institutional, and organizational challenges. He has specialized expertise in research methodology, advanced data analysis, predictive modeling, intelligent systems design, and the application of analytical techniques to support evidence-based decision-making.
